summary: FMD Server acts as a self-hosted backend for the Find My Device Android application. It allows you to receive location updates and send remote control commands to your mobile devices without relying on third-party cloud infrastructure. The application is written in Go and distributed as a container image.
goodFor: Users who want to track and manage their Android devices independently while keeping location data within their own private infrastructure.
watchOut: Activity in the repository is currently minimal, which may mean slow responses to upstream Android changes or security issues.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, it typically requires persistent storage for state data and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination securely.
